quantitative_cell_tail.uniform_elementary_tail: j>J implies p<6m/(3J+5), hence log-prime tail <= theta(6m/(3J+5))=O(m/J)

scope.not_covered: The actual high-degree Hasse/Bockstein cancellation depends on j, p, and s and is not proved to lie in this fixed-polynomial class.
scope.proved_thin_class: For fixed j, any zero set contained in finitely many congruences F(j,s)=0 mod p for fixed nonzero integer polynomials has log-weight O_j(log m); finite unions in j have zero rate, and the convergent cell tail then gives zero rate for such a bandwise certificate.
